intro: Welcome to TrackMyRMA. In the next few minutes you'll see how a printer service centre sets up the app from scratch, adds its masters and care packs, and then takes a faulty part all the way from the customer, to the OEM, and back again.
agenda: We'll follow a demo company, Sharma Printer Care, through eleven short steps. All the names and serial numbers you'll see are made up.
steps: TrackMyRMA runs in any web browser, on a computer, a tablet or a phone. There's nothing to install.
If you're new, click Start free trial. You get thirty days with every feature, and no card is needed.
Type your company name, a short company code that your team will use to log in, your name and your work email.
Then press Create my company.
That's it. A setup link is on its way to your inbox, and you are the Admin of your new company.
Open the link from the email, and choose a strong password.
Next, two-step login. Open an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google or Microsoft Authenticator, and scan this QR code.
Type the six digit code the app shows you, and press Verify.
You'll get ten recovery codes. Keep them somewhere safe. Each one lets you in once if you ever lose your phone.
And you're in. This is your dashboard. It's empty for now, so let's set things up.
Open Company settings. Upload your logo, and fill in your contact details. They appear on printouts, and on the emails your customers receive.
Here you set the email that goes to your OEM: who receives it, and the message. Words in double braces are filled in from each R M A automatically.
The OEM Excel form is the R M A form your OEM asks for. Use the built-in form, or upload your OEM's own template.
Customer status updates are on by default. Your customer gets an email with a private tracking link at every step.
And backups: a weekly copy of your data by email, plus a full download with photos and P D Fs whenever you want.
When you're done, press Save settings.
Now, your team. Open Users and security, and click Add user.
Enter their name, email and role. Technicians raise and update R M As. Managers can also look after masters, imports and reports.
They receive an invite by email, and set up their own password and two-step login.
Auto sign-out logs people out after a few minutes without activity. Useful on shared computers.
Next, masters. These are the lists the app uses everywhere. Start with OEMs: add each brand you service.
Products group your models under each OEM, for example desktop printers and industrial printers.
Add each model with its product and device category. Printers get print head claim rules, and a full device history.
Your models are ready. From now on, when you type a model on an R M A, these are suggested.
Then customers: name, contact person, phone, email and city. New R M As fill these details in for you.
Have a long customer list? Go to Import, choose Customers, and pick your Excel or C S V file. Match each column to a field.
Then press Import. If a customer already exists, it's updated, not duplicated.
Now all your customers are in one list.
Next, care packs. These are the OEM extended warranties you sell with printers. Click Register care pack.
The fastest way is to import your sales invoice P D F. You can also load the invoice from Zoho Books, or type it in.
TrackMyRMA reads the invoice number, date, customer, model, care pack length and all the serial numbers. Just check them.
Then press Register care pack.
It's registered as Unverified. The next step is to link the purchase order you placed with the OEM.
Paste the serial numbers from the P O and press Check. Every printer on your invoice has to be on the P O, and here they all match.
Now enter the OEM's invoice number, date and amount, and save.
Upload the OEM invoice P D F, and the care pack becomes one hundred percent verified. When you pay the OEM, mark it paid.
Back on the care pack list, the status buttons show at a glance what is still unverified, P O validated, or fully verified.
Now the main event. A customer calls with a faulty printer. Press New R M A.
Pick the customer, then type the model and the printer's serial number. TrackMyRMA instantly tells you this printer is covered by a care pack, and until when.
Describe the faulty part, its serial number, the print head mileage and the fault. Add photos from your phone or computer. They go into the OEM form too.
Press Raise R M A.
The R M A gets its own number, and your customer is emailed a private link to follow its progress.
Generate OEM Excel fills in your OEM's R M A form with all the details and photos. No more copying and pasting.
Email OEM prepares the email with the Excel attached, and sends it straight from TrackMyRMA.
Check the email. Everything is already filled in from the R M A. Press Send.
When the OEM replies with their own R M A number, click Enter OEM R M A number.
Type it in and save.
Parts usually go to the OEM together. In OEM batches, tick the R M As going in this box, add the courier, the docket number and your delivery challan P D F.
Press Dispatch. The packing list downloads, and every R M A in the batch moves to Dispatched to OEM.
When the repaired or replacement part comes back, press Goods received from OEM.
Note the serial number of the new part. It's recorded in the printer's device history.
Then dispatch it to your customer: the challan number, the challan P D F, and the courier docket.
On the Photos tab, everything stays together: the inbound photos, your delivery challan, and the OEM batch challan.
And this is what your customer sees: a private page with the live status of their R M A. No login, and no phone calls to chase you.
They also get an email like this one at every step.
Once the customer confirms everything is fine, close the R M A as repaired. Done.
The History tab keeps every step, with who did it and when.
Back on the dashboard, you see every R M A at each stage. Click any stage to open that list.
Check printer cover tells you in a second whether any serial number is under a care pack.
The R M A list lets you search and filter everything.
Reminders show what is waiting on you. Admins and Managers also get this list by email every morning at nine.
Device history shows every R M A for one printer, ready to print or export for your customer or the OEM.
And Reports let you filter and export to Excel.
Your data stays private. TrackMyRMA support cannot download your data unless your Admin switches on support access, and every copy of your data is listed here.
The dashboard explains exactly how your data is protected.
When your trial ends, pay online by U P I, card or netbanking in Plan and billing.
And if you're ever stuck, Help on this page explains every screen, step by step.
features: So, why do service centres use TrackMyRMA? It fills your OEM's own R M A form and emails it. It checks care packs against the OEM's purchase order, invoice and payment. Your customers follow their repair on a private page. And you get device history, OEM batches and challans, on any device, with two-step login for everyone.
end: Start your free thirty day trial at trackmyrma dot com. No card needed. Thanks for watching.
